name: Sakura Sumika
source:
Editor of the gourmet magazine "Premiere" who visits "Curio" to interview Sayaka. This woman is a kind person, so even when Sayaka made mistakes, Sumika laughed and encouraged her.

Only appears in Sayaka's route in the game's consumer ports.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%82%B7%E3%83%A7%E3%82%B3%E3%83%A9_%E3%80%9Cmaid_cafe_%22curio%22%E3%80%9C]Wikipedia[/url].]
